purpose: Annotate an earlier evidence record; the annotated record is not modified.

finding.summary: The 1,011-record GCS smoke run was executed with the locked-epoch admission gate replaced by a no-op, so that run establishes chain behaviour under real GCS concurrency but establishes nothing about the gate.
finding.mechanism: engineering/phase2/smoke_audit_chain_gcs.py assigns g.require_locked_audit_epoch = lambda: None on the single GcsStore instance under test, after asserting the target bucket is readable, unlocked, carries no retention policy, has a name containing 'smoke', differs from the main bucket, and is entirely empty, and after requiring WOUNDAI_AUDIT_SMOKE=1.
finding.scope_of_substitution: instance attribute on one object inside one short-lived test process

why_it_matters: A reader of validation.gcs_smoke could otherwise conclude that require_locked_audit_epoch() had been exercised against a real bucket during that run. It had not.
The gate's first execution against a genuinely locked bucket happened separately, after the lock, and is recorded below.

gate_actually_exercised_on.result: PASS: exact locked seven-year epoch accepted; whole bucket is empty; no object was written

does_not_establish: that the smoke run validated the locked-epoch gate
any change to the annotated record
